messages.text: BL-1851 🎵 in progress — A local seat's tuning report compares its work across the settings it ran with - one command groups the seat's qwen requests by the settings in force when each ran (BL-1850's record, including rows written by hand mid-session) and by how Ollama served the model (layers on GPU, KV cache), and prints per group the time to first token, prefill and decode speed, output and thinking tokens, chat compressions and tool-call failures, and what differs between groups
